title: Check: What Makes the Internet Special

questions.prompt: Your laptop moves from Wi-Fi to an Ethernet cable, and every program keeps using IP the same way. Which of the four ideas is that?
Delivery is confirmed by the two endpoints, not by each router along the way. Which idea is that?
An email client from one vendor sends mail to a server from a completely different vendor, and it just works. Which idea makes that possible?
Universal interconnection means any host can reach any other host, whatever networks lie between them.
When a published RFC turns out to contain a mistake, the IETF edits that RFC to fix it.
How does the IETF make decisions?
What is a proposal called before it's published as an RFC?
